anchor.intro: {TIMECHECK} Welcome to GLC News. Ahead: F.B.I. co-deputy director Andrew Bailey resigns, Tesla pushes its Roadster event to October fifteenth, SpaceX Starship reaches orbit for the first time, and Belarus registers its first crypto banks.
anchor.outro: Thanks Isabella for that report. That wraps this GLC News bulletin. Thank you for listening.

reporters.handoff: First, Edith on the F.B.I. departure.

stories.topic: FBI co-deputy director Andrew Bailey resigns
stories.script: F.B.I. co-deputy director Andrew Bailey has announced his resignation after just over a year at the bureau. N.B.C. News, Politico, the Washington Post, and Bloomberg Law report the move. Bailey leaves one of the bureau's top deputy roles with no detailed public reason yet released for the exit.

reporters.signoff: I am Edith, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Edith. Mark with two stories, starting with Tesla.

stories.topic: Tesla postpones Roadster event to October 15
stories.script: Tesla is postponing its Roadster event to October fifteenth because of severe weather. The move was confirmed in an official Tesla post, with Electrek noting the weather context around the delay. Fans who expected an earlier reveal will now wait until mid-October for the next Roadster milestone.

stories.topic: Starship first orbit and Starlink deploy
stories.script: SpaceX Starship reached orbit for the first time, deployed twenty-six upgraded Starlink satellites, then splashed down in the Pacific near Hawaii. An early engine failure cut a roughly ten-hour plan to about three hours, according to Bloomberg, Fortune, Space dot com, and Good Morning America. The flight still marks Starship's first successful orbital reach and satellite deployment.

reporters.signoff: I am Mark, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Mark. Isabella on Belarus and crypto banking.

stories.topic: Belarus registers first two crypto banks
stories.script: Belarus has officially registered its first two crypto banks, according to state media outlet S.B. by, with corroboration from CryptoBriefing and KuCoin News. The approvals put Belarus among countries building formal banking channels for digital assets. Details on which operators cleared registration and what products they can offer are still rolling out.

reporters.signoff: I am Isabella, for GLC News.
